title: Visualizing Distribution Coverage in Generative Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38853v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion distillation is widely adopted to accelerate sampling, and the resulting few-step models are broadly believed to match or even surpass their multi-step teachers in generation. However, standard evaluations such as GenEval2 typically draw only one sample per prompt, so improved scores may fail to reveal losses in distribution coverage. We therefore revisit whether distilled models truly match their teachers beyond single-draw performance using \textbf{pass@$\mathbf{k}$}, which measures the probability that at least one of $k$ independent samples satisfies a quality criterion. At $k{=}1$, pass@$k$ reduces to standard single-draw evaluation. As $k$ grows, the curve reveals whether additional draws find genuinely different successes or merely revisit the same modes, directly exposing how broadly a model covers the space of valid outputs. translated_title: 生成式扩散模型中分布覆盖范围的可视化
translated_abstract: 扩散蒸馏被广泛用于加速采样，由此产生的少步模型被普遍认为在生成效果上能够媲美甚至超越其多步教师模型。然而，诸如GenEval2等标准评估通常对每个提示词只抽取一个样本，因此提升的分数可能无法揭示分布覆盖范围的损失。为此，我们使用pass@k重新审视蒸馏模型在单次采样之外是否真正匹配其教师模型。pass@k衡量的是k个独立样本中至少有一个满足质量标准的概率。当k=1时，pass@k退化为标准的单次采样评估；随着k增大，该曲线能够揭示额外的采样究竟是找到了真正不同的成功案例，还是仅仅重复访问相同的模式，从而直接展示模型对有效输出空间的覆盖广度。我们首先表明，无分类器引导（CFG）——其质量与覆盖范围之间的权衡已被广……
tldr: 提出使用pass@k指标评估扩散蒸馏模型的分布覆盖能力，揭示单次采样评估可能掩盖少步蒸馏模型相对于多步教师模型在输出多样性上的损失。
en_tdlr: Proposing pass@k as a metric to evaluate distribution coverage in distilled diffusion models, revealing that single-draw evaluations may mask the loss of output diversity in few-step distilled models compared to their multi-step teachers.
